paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 121b, where Rav Yosef permitted Chiyuai’s wife to remarry; see there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Yevamot 121b identifies Chiyuai as the man reported dead and Rav Yosef as the sage permitting Chiyuai’s wife to remarry.

The named William Davidson Yevamot 121b paragraph reports Chiyuai dead and says that Rav Yosef permitted his wife to marry. This supports the possessive direction retained in the English and the preceding note. The later episode in that same paragraph has another man and an alternative attribution to Rava; it is not merged into Chiyuai’s notice.
